bonuses.requirements: Alphabet Plans to Join $185 Billion 'Golden Dome' Missile Defense ProgramHomeFeedNewsAlphabet Plans to Join $185 Billion 'Golden Dome' Missile Defense ProgramAlphabet Plans to Join $185 Billion 'Golden Dome' Missile Defense Program10/30 22:40On October 31, sources revealed that Alphabet Inc. (GOOG.O), Google's parent company, is in talks with the Pentagon to participate in the $185 billion 'Golden Dome' missile defense program initiated by Trump. The focus will be on data security, storage, networking, and cybersecurity capabilities to ensure that data transmission for military command and control software is less susceptible to attacks. Discussions are still in the early stages, and Google's networking company Aalyria is also involved in the preparatory alliance.
